canonical.name: Smooth Poisson bivector and global bracket convention
canonical.detail: Defines a smooth skew contravariant 2-tensor in charts with its transition law, the induced coordinate bracket, and Poisson Jacobi condition. No rank or nondegeneracy assumption is imposed.

canonical.name: Coordinate Jacobi and Schouten self-bracket criterion
canonical.detail: Proves chart independence, the biderivation rules, and Jacobi equivalently to vanishing of J^{ijk}; fixes [pi,pi]_{SN}^{ijk}=2J^{ijk}.

canonical.name: Coefficientwise formal associative deformation over the reals
canonical.detail: Defines the finite coefficient convolution on A[[hbar]], unit, reduction modulo hbar, and hbar-adic continuity, without analytic convergence.

canonical.name: First-order skew term of an associative deformation is Poisson
canonical.detail: Derives Jacobi and both biderivation identities from the associative commutator and product identities.

canonical.name: Differential star product and real first-order normalization
canonical.detail: Requires bidifferential coefficients, a preserved unit, and B_1(f,g)-B_1(g,f)={f,g}_pi; excludes numerical-hbar convergence and classification claims.

canonical.name: Hochschild cochains, differential, insertion bracket, and normalized multidifferential subcomplex
canonical.detail: States the standard delta formula and signed Gerstenhaber insertion/bracket conventions, and defines the normalized multidifferential cohomology used below.

canonical.name: Shifted Hochschild differential graded Lie algebra
canonical.detail: Proves the insertion pre-Lie identity, graded Lie identities, square-zero differential, signed delta relation, and closure of normalized multidifferential cochains.

canonical.name: Finite-order Hochschild obstruction and extension criterion
canonical.detail: Defines O_n, proves it is a normalized multidifferential 3-cocycle, and proves extension through order n exactly when delta B_n=O_n; makes no all-orders existence assertion.

canonical.name: Formal differential gauge equivalence and first-coefficient invariant
canonical.detail: Defines unit-preserving coefficientwise differential change of variables.

canonical.name: Gauge changes first coefficient by a Hochschild coboundary
canonical.detail: Expands the gauge map through order hbar, checks the delta sign, and proves the skew part is invariant.

examples.detail: On R^3, computes the coordinate brackets and Jacobiator x^2-y^2, which is nonzero at (1,0,0); the local first-order theorem excludes it from any associative deformation.

Defines the formal exponential product for every constant real skew tensor, proves coefficientwise finiteness, unit, associativity, first-order normalization, zero/degenerate cases, and the canonical symplectic sign.
